title: lannea obovata
intro: Lannea obovata, commonly known as African cherry or bushwillow, is a plant species belonging to the Anacardiaceae family, characterized by its small, yellowish or greenish flowers and oval-shaped leaves. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lannea obovata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Lannea obovata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess significant pharmacological activities.
